voices.name: Harsh - Authoritative Podcast Host
voices.description: Young Indian Voice, with strong effects and authority.

voices.name: Harsh - Calm
voices.description: This is for calm Malayalam voice narration.

voices.name: Harsh Chhikara
voices.description: Harsh Chhikara's deep, smooth voice combines standard Hindi with a Haryanvi accent, creating an authentic North Indian tone. His warm delivery features a medium pace, natural pauses, and clear articulation. He adeptly shifts between serious, motivational, and empathetic styles, making him relatable to Hindi-speaking audiences. Ideal for documentaries and public speaking, he uses controlled pitch changes for powerful storytelling while maintaining clarity.

voices.name: Villain - Harsh, Abrasive, and Volatile
voices.description: A villain voice with a raw, gravelly texture and controlled intensity. Dark, commanding, and intimidating without being overbearing, capable of powerful moments as well as a steady, simmering menace. Grounded and rough-edged, well-suited for antagonists, bosses, warlords, and complex enemies in animation, gaming, and cinematic storytelling.

voices.name: Harsh - Soft & Gentle
voices.description: A soft, gentle and smooth voice of an Indian male which is moderate in volume

voices.name: Harsh - Social Media Explainer Voice, Classic & Commanding
voices.description:
Harsh’s clarity, calmness and pace make him ideal for step-by-step explainers, and his natural tonal modulations carry a touch of smart sarcasm—great for humorous educational content.

Best suited for social media and other short video formats, this voice is a go-to for content creators, D2C brands, education startups, and infotainment pages looking to stand out in the crowded scroll.

voices.name: Harsh - Deep, Calm and Encouraging
voices.description: Harsh’s voice is a rare blend of clarity, warmth, and composure—perfectly suited for deep storytelling and narration across genres. Whether it’s mythological tales, thoughtful reflections, lifestyle podcasts, audiobooks, children stories or insightful explainers, his delivery captures attention with ease. His mature, expressive tone makes him ideal for audio platforms long-form storytelling platforms like Radio and Spotify, and knowledge-based mobile apps.

voices.name: Harsh - Resonant, Serious and Dramatic
voices.description:
Harsh brings a resonant, authoritative tone perfect for immersive documentary narration. His voice shines in wildlife, nature, mythological and ancient history-focused content—balancing clarity with a touch of dramatic intrigue.

Perfect for long-form YouTube documentaries, wildlife OTT shows, travel series, and historical explainer channels.

voices.name: Harsh - Warm, Expressive and Natural
voices.description: This is a warm, expressive Indian male voice. Youthful yet mature tone, making it ideal for content creators, influencers, and brands looking to add a relatable, authentic Indian flavour to their social media videos. Whether it’s storytelling, motivation, education, or casual reels — this voice blends clarity with charisma.

voices.name: Harsh - Deep, Whisper and Steady
voices.description:
A bold, captivating voice built for tension, thrill, and spine-chilling storytelling.

Harsh delivers each line with intensity and control—perfect for crime podcasts, suspense YouTube channels, drama audiobooks, and dark narration content. Whether unraveling a twisted mystery or narrating a late-night thriller, his voice keeps listeners hooked. Best suited for platforms like Spotify, Audible, YouTube, and TV-style narration.

voices.name: Opsy - Harsh, Direct and Matter-of-fact
voices.description: A 50 year old Nigerian-American voice with a Nigerian with a high pitch Yoruba accent.
